name: Crystalwell Spyglass
description: A compact elven field optic built from polished crystal and resin-set lenses housed in a Silverbark Ash composite barrel — lighter and quieter than the brass-and-glass spyglasses imported into the realm. The crystal lensing gives clear distance work without the fragility of common glasswork or the weight of metal housing.
narrative_effects: Reduces difficulty of distant visual observation where line of sight is available.
Lighter and far more durable in the field than realm-side brass spyglasses; less likely to fail under hard travel or weather.
Standard issue for elven scouts, Heartwarden field watches, and Greenshield ranger circuits.
